### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. vitelliform macular dystrophy 4  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.775)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:6055)

**Proposed mechanism:** IMPG1 (HGNC:5530) —DISRUPTS→ IMPG1 protein complex assembly and extracellular matrix organization in the photoreceptor outer segment (GO:0005615); IMPG1 protein complex assembly and extracellular matrix organization in the photoreceptor outer segment (GO:0005615) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal photoreceptor outer segment structure (HP:0011721); Abnormal photoreceptor outer segment structure (HP:0011721) —LEADS_TO→ Macular dystrophy (HP:0000573). Loss-of-function mutations in IMPG1 disrupt the assembly and organization of IMPG1-containing protein complexes within the photoreceptor outer segment extracellular matrix. This disruption leads to abnormal photoreceptor outer segment structure, ultimately manifesting as macular dystrophy.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in IMPG1 that cause a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect, or demonstration that the two diseases are caused by distinct, non-overlapping sets of IMPG1 variants with different downstream consequences. _(variant: rs754542991)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of IMPG1 in these distinct macular dystrophies could lead to the development of targeted therapies that aim to restore IMPG1 function or mitigate the downstream consequences of its loss, potentially benefiting patients with both conditions.
